answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 38311 Country: India Title: As per the sunnah and best ways what is the perfect time for nikah Question: As per the sunnah and best ways what is the perfect time for nikah? In which month and date as per Islamic calendar and after which salah? Answer ID: 38311 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 770/770/M=1433) There is no specific month meant for nikah. You can fix any month as per your ease. However it is mustahab on Friday after Jumuah or Asr salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
